statements.text: The war in Ukraine has shown us that investments in data, AI and compute are what's going to allow us to stay ahead of the curve in a future conflict. How are you thinking about taking a more data-driven and AI-enabled posture in SOUTHCOM? [...] SOUTHCOM continues to lean forward as an experimentation hub for emerging technologies and is actively leveraging and pursuing Artificial Learning and Machine Learning (AL/ML) for improved data management, analytics, and dissemination.
statements.context: Written question submitted by Representative Patrick Ryan to General Laura Richardson during a House Armed Services Committee hearing on U.S. military posture.

statements.text: AI will bring the biggest economic and social transformation of our lifetime, and the battle lines are being drawn. On one side are a handful of tech oligarchs who will stop at nothing in the quest to make trillions and grow their own power. On the other side are the American people; hard-working folks sick of an economy rigged against them, and worried about what this AI transformation will mean for their families.
A handful of the richest people in the history of the world are spending millions to defeat him because they’re terrified of a true leader with the courage and the expertise to take them on.

This should have been a moment for all of us to work together and keep our kids safe online. Instead, Big Tech and their army of lobbyists hijacked and watered down what was previously a common-sense bipartisan bill.
statements.venue: Social media post reported by Daily Freeman, on the KIDS Act vote

statements.text: Without a duty of care provision, the KIDS Act gives Big Tech a free pass to keep putting profits over the safety of our kids.
statements.venue: Social media post reported by Daily Freeman, on the KIDS Act vote

statements.text: I’m so proud that here in the Hudson Valley we’re standing together and fighting back against these data center projects. We’re not going to let anyone — especially not a bunch of billionaire tech oligarchs — come in here and poison our water, drive up our utility bills, and build this powerful technology that even they acknowledge could have devastating impacts for humankind.
statements.venue: NY Governor's office press release on data center moratorium event

statements.text: We need to slow it down [...] We need to pump the brakes because there’s a lot of risk.
They jack up utility bills that are already too high. They poison our water.
statements.venue: Daily Freeman interview/forum, on data centers

statements.text: I have real concerns...It would be like saying, 'Do you want someone to come build a nuclear weapon in your neighborhood if they're willing to pay for it?' No
